question: What status does the qualified hero-animal attain after passing through the listed rite actions?
premises: The hero-animal has been seen, sprinkled, witnessed, obtained, taken up and joined by rite actions.
Through those actions it is extinguished in the sense required by this rite.
As a result it attains a status described as eightfold, higher and supreme.
inference: The hero-animal, qualified by seeing, sprinkling, witnessing, obtaining, taking up and joining, is extinguished by rite action and attains an eightfold, higher, supreme status.
uncertainties: Technical meaning of extinguished is not defined by this verse alone.
Eightfold status cannot be unpacked from this verse and remains open.
plain_english: The hero-animal, having been seen, sprinkled, witnessed, obtained, taken up and joined in the rite, is extinguished and attains a status that is eightfold, higher and supreme.
